answer: A concrete rule the ledger can enforce: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because whisper only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, hollow is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any beacon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
